EXHIBIT A

NOTICE OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD DEVELOPMENT
RELEVANT TO PENDING RULE 72(a) OBJECTIONS

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine provides notice of a subsequent record development
bearing on his pending Rule 72(a) Objections. ECF No. 66.

1. ECF No. 66 challenges, among other matters, the requirement in ECF No. 64 that
Plaintiff provide a redlined comparison of the proposed Second Amended and Supplemental
Complaint.

2. On September 18, 2026, after the objections were filed, Defendants Katie Hall and
NCMEC filed ECF No. 74. ECF No. 74 states that, “despite numerous efforts, undersigned counsel

has been unable to ‘reverse-engineer’ a redline comparison of the two documents via either Adobe

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document 76-1 Filed 09/18/26 Page 2 of 2 PagelD#

or Word.” ECF No. 74 at 4. ECF No. 74 also states that “the format of the factual allegations have
changed.” ECF No. 74 at 5.

3. Plaintiff encountered the same practical difficulty. The two documents do not have
the textual relationship produced by discrete tracked amendments.

4. This Notice seeks no relief beyond that requested in ECF No. 66. It is submitted so

that the Court may consider this development in resolving the pending objections.

Date: September 18, 2026 Respectfully submitted,
